comment_text.value: As an investor, I worry about churn. Year 2...N customers are more profitable. Great. But what happens when <New Startup X> throws billions into blitzscaling their new delivery app? There goes your most profitable cohort, to the next (temporarily cheaper) delivery platform. And food delivery apps aren't a classically 'sticky' business: it's centered on ephemeral transactions.

hits.author: JMTQp8lwXL
